description: Paint 1..100 pixels in one payment of n x 0.1 USDC (test-USDC on Base Sepolia (free from faucet.circle.com)). The first call answers with an x402 PaymentRequired; pay it with an x402 MCP client. All or nothing: a pixel someone else holds means nothing is painted and nothing is charged. x, y in 0..99 with (0,0) top left; color is "#rrggbb" only, e.g. {"pixels": [{"x": 10, "y": 20, "color": "#ff0000"}]}. If the answer says pending, do NOT pay again: call get_order later.

color.description: "#" and exactly six hex digits, e.g. "#ff0000" is red. Not a name ("red"), not "#f00", not rgb(), no alpha.

name: paint_pixels
